summary: @JeremiahLee Why not make your personal website an instance in the fediverse rather than hopping on to Mastodon? The values may align, but you still don't own control data. Any server admin can delete your data any time they want.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: @JeremiahLee Why not make your personal website an instance in the fediverse rather than hopping on to Mastodon? The values may align, but you still don't own control data. Any server admin can delete your data any time they want.
